exposed_static_prefetch.why: instruction words are static program fields (go is a separate wire); the sequencer streams op i+1 into the 2-deep column FIFO while op i runs (every ME op occupies >= 2 cycles), so only beats issued after a pipeline drain are exposed

f1_reset.why: reset is not on the token path; release takes <= 44 pipelined hops once at power-on

adopted_figure: bound +217 cycles/token (0.121%) until the RTL prefetch is measured
